Permanent Brow Restoration
The Eyebrow Transplant
Eyebrow Transplant at ISAAC Luxe is an advanced cosmetic hair restoration procedure that uses your own natural hair to reshape sparse brows and restore natural growth — customised to your facial aesthetics under the care of Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta.

Using advanced magnification techniques, hair follicles are placed with careful attention to growth direction and density for a seamless, natural result. The procedure takes 3–5 hours under local anaesthesia — no general anaesthesia required — and you can relax, listen to music, or watch TV throughout.

Why Choose Transplantation

Permanent, Natural Results

Uses your own natural hair for a permanent solution that grows and ages naturally — unlike temporary alternatives like microblading.

Precision Placement

Advanced magnification techniques ensure natural growth direction and density.

What It Treats
Over-Plucked Brows Naturally Thin Eyebrows Post-Tattoo Coverage Hair Loss From Scars or Trauma

What to Expect
Your Treatment Journey
01

Consultation

Contact ISAAC Luxe to check your eligibility and schedule a consultation for your brow transformation.

02

The Procedure

Performed under local anaesthesia over 3–5 hours, with advanced magnification techniques ensuring a seamless, natural result — many patients relax with music or TV throughout.

03

Aftercare

Expect mild redness, inflammation, or tiny scabs that typically subside within a few days to a week; many patients return to work within 1–2 days.

04

Results Timeline

Transplanted hair follows its natural growth cycle, shedding initially before regrowing over 10–12 weeks.

Who Is This For
Suitable for men and women with over-plucked, thin, or patchy brows, or hair loss from scars, trauma, or medical treatment. Transplanted hair follows its natural growth cycle — expect initial shedding before regrowth begins at 10–12 weeks.

The Visionary Behind ISAAC Luxe
Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta
Founder and Medical Director of ISAAC Luxe / Aesthetic Physician, and award-winning cosmetologist — Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta is one of India's most sought-after skin experts.

With over 15 years of experience in aesthetics, Dr. Geetika has built a reputation for personalised care and delivering results with minimal risk. Her clientele includes celebrities, influencers, and discerning individuals who trust her expertise.

She is a pioneer in introducing globally advanced treatments to India — from AI-integrated diagnostics and cutting-edge IV therapy to advanced body sculpting technology — setting new benchmarks in luxury dermatology.

Qualifications

MBBS from Govt. Medical College, Patiala. Post-graduation in Aesthetic Medicine from Cardiff University, UK. Diploma in Aesthetic Medicine from the American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine.

Global Expertise

Attended numerous international workshops and conferences globally. Known for blending ancient and modern scientific techniques to deliver trusted, clinically tested treatments.

Celebrity Trusted

Preferred aesthetic destination for Bollywood celebrities, fashion icons, social media influencers, and high-profile personalities across India's entertainment and fashion industry.

Three-Tier Philosophy

Unique AI-driven approach to long-term beauty built on three pillars: Treatment, Prevention, and Maintenance — ensuring lasting results and healthier skin over time.
